Yes. The 2022 loss meets the corroboration rule.

- **Event:** Hansen GFC shows 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss in 2022, about 3.41% of the 17.6 ha asset. That is above the 0.5 ha minimum event size.
- **Independent reference:** JRC GFC2020 V4 maps 100% of the event area as forest in 2020, well above the 50% agreement threshold.
- **Later year observed:** The annual series runs through 2025, so later years were observed for this event.

The MGAP 2021 national map is consistent with this. It classes 0.5 ha of the event area as native forest, none as planted, and 0.1 ha as outside mapped forest.

An additional 0.2 ha of 2022 loss came in patches under 0.5 ha. These were not counted as an event and are not part of the 0.6 ha.

The run uses an early-access engine version (land-change/1), so treat the result with that in mind.
